# T3 ChatGPT Agent Workspace Preparation Report v2.2

## Result

Everything obtainable in the preparation environment has been acquired, segregated by trust level, hash-locked, and wired into repeatable acquisition scripts. The workspace is ready to perform the authoritative source checkout, untouched baseline capture, and S00 entry in one command on Windows.

## Acquired and verified

- Planning Package v2 and all supplied checksums.
- Public repository identity and audited commit `c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526`.
- Exact commit metadata and selected exact GitHub blob identities.
- Exact root, server, desktop, and devcontainer metadata snapshots.
- Published `t3@0.0.28` runtime reference tarball with SHA-256.
- Direct tarballs for Parcel Watcher, Graphology, WXT, Execa, DOMPurify, fast-check, MSW, MCP TypeScript SDK, Playwright, node-pty, xterm.js, OpenAI SDK, and ast-grep N-API.
- Cached Windows x64 Node `24.13.1`, pnpm `11.10.0`, and Corepack `0.35.0` archives.
- Official Node.js `24.13.1` Windows x64 fallback URL and SHA-256.
- Exact-SHA source acquisition with `git fsck`, clean-tree validation, reusable Git bundle generation, transactional intake, and source lock.
- One-command Windows prerequisite, source, baseline, and verification entrypoint.
- Immutable workspace manifest covering the prepared control plane and cached materials.

## Search for an existing source copy

Current attachments and the File Library were searched for an exact T3 checkout, source archive, or Git bundle. The available items were planning documents and prior preparation reports; no complete source copy or exact-commit bundle was available to ingest.

## Trust model

The npm runtime and direct dependency archives are references or evaluation seeds. They are not silently substituted for the audited source. Only a full checkout in `source/primary` with `source/SOURCE_LOCK.json` may authorize implementation.

## Remaining external requirements

- Networked Windows 11 x64 execution.
- Full checkout of the public repository at the audited SHA.
- First `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, because the included direct tarballs are not a complete transitive offline store.
- Windows-native build, sandbox, installer, signing, Defender, and UI Automation evidence.

## Windows entrypoint

```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass
.\scripts\acquire_everything.ps1 -InstallBuildTools
```

The script refuses the wrong commit, a dirty baseline, material hash drift, failed Git integrity, malformed PowerShell, immutable-workspace drift, and failed baseline commands. Refusal is more useful here than a decorative green checkmark.
## S00 execution addendum (2026-07-13T19:36:30.563128+00:00)

S00 was entered and immediately blocked at exact source acquisition. The official Git clone was attempted and failed with DNS resolution (`github.com`, exit 128). The prior `ready` status was incorrect because the same record declared the source absent; it is now `blocked_source_acquisition`, and validation rejects that contradiction.

No source code has been modified. Required baseline reports now exist with explicit `BLOCKED` or `PARTIAL METADATA ONLY` status. Published v0.0.28 sourcemap sources were extracted strictly as non-authoritative research material: 809 first-party files from 385 maps, with zero content conflicts.

## Exact-commit snapshot amendment (2026-07-13T21:19:52.960373+00:00)

The user authorized a verified exact-commit snapshot as an S00 fallback. The workspace now contains a transactional verifier/importer that recomputes every Git blob SHA-1, reconstructs the complete recursive Git tree, verifies the upstream root tree SHA, preserves executable and symlink modes, rejects unsafe paths/submodules/LFS gaps, initializes the local import repository, and writes schema-v2 provenance locks.

The importer passes adversarial fixture tests. It has **not** been run against T3 source because the connected GitHub interface can retrieve a known file or blob but exposes no complete recursive-tree enumeration or exact-commit archive export. Code search and the commit diff are not exhaustive. S00 is therefore `blocked_exact_snapshot_tree_enumeration`; no source mutation is authorized.

# T3 ChatGPT Agent Build Workspace v2.2

This is an evidence-gated implementation workspace for the Windows-first T3 Code fork described in Planning Package v2.

## Locked baseline

- Repository: `pingdotgg/t3code`
- Commit: `c1ec1915fc16f3dc1ec5d47d9a97f6210a574526`
- Node: `24.13.1`
- pnpm: `11.10.0`
- Target: Windows 11 x64

## One-command Windows acquisition

```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass
.\scripts\acquire_everything.ps1 -InstallBuildTools
```

That command verifies the included cache, installs the pinned Node/pnpm/Corepack toolchain from local archives, installs any missing Windows system prerequisites, checks out the exact audited commit, records a portable Git bundle, ingests source transactionally, and captures the untouched baseline before any implementation edit.

## Existing checkout or source archive

```powershell
python .\scripts\ingest_source.py --directory C:\path\to\t3code
# History-free archives are accepted only when explicitly declared authoritative:
python .\scripts\ingest_source.py --archive C:\path\to\source.zip --authoritative-no-history
.\scripts\capture_baseline.ps1
```

## Included materials

- Planning Package v2 with verified checksums.
- Exact audited repository metadata and selected exact file snapshots.
- `t3@0.0.28` published runtime reference, clearly segregated from source authority.
- Hash-locked direct package archives for migration-candidate evaluation.
- Cached Windows x64 Node 24.13.1 executable package, pnpm 11.10.0, and Corepack 0.35.0.
- Windows and Unix source-acquisition scripts with exact-commit and `git fsck` gates.
- A reusable exact-commit Git bundle is generated automatically after the first successful checkout.
- 16 dependency-ordered implementation sections, 10 ADR templates, and 42 v2-derived gates.
- Immutable workspace manifest plus material-level SHA-256 manifest.

## Current hard boundary

This archive cannot contain the full audited Git checkout because the preparation sandbox cannot download GitHub archives or Git objects, and no exact source checkout or Git bundle was present in the uploaded files. The connected GitHub API independently verified the public repository, pinned commit, commit metadata, and selected file blobs. Implementation remains blocked until `source/primary` is populated and `source/SOURCE_LOCK.json` records the exact local tree. The Windows acquisition script closes that gap automatically on the first networked Windows run.

The direct package cache is intentionally not described as a complete offline pnpm store. The first `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` still requires approved network access, after which its resolved store can be exported as evidence and an offline cache.

## Control rules

- One primary integration section at a time.
- Failed gates block dependent sections.
- Third-party replacements remain behind adapters and feature flags until migration gates pass.
- No source edit before untouched baseline evidence is captured.
- No Windows release claim from Linux-only evidence.
- Cached reference artifacts never become source authority.

See `docs/BUILD_INPUTS.md`, `docs/WINDOWS_EXECUTION.md`, and `PREPARATION_REPORT.md`.
